name: Composition
purpose: execute a DWH-declared composition graph in the browser while preserving separate authority for hierarchy, declarations, authorization and renderer state

pageContext.authority: all hierarchy-derived fields are detached projections from canonical SiteTree truth

shell.navigation: .we-nav with .we-nav-item children derived from Navigation projections
rules: addressable navigation items render as links using canonical SiteTree paths
unaddressable structural navigation items do not invent href values
aria-current=page marks only the exact current addressable item
shell composition uses only public .we-* presentation semantics
slot identity is bound to one canonical resolved projector id
renderer mount cannot silently replace slot projector identity
projector heading remains outside renderer-owned live boundary
renderer lifecycle and state publication remain owned by the renderer runtime
one projector failure is contained to its own slot result and boundary

semantics: destroy all registered projector boundaries through renderer lifecycle cleanup
reject new projector slots after composition destruction

rules: DWH owns canonical composition declarations; WebEngine executes them
Composition consumes #SITE and other DWH projections; it does not become declaration authority
Composition delegates renderer lifecycle to the renderer subsystem
Composition does not execute domain business semantics directly
Composition does not infer authorization from visibility or runtime state
IAM identity and AccessCore authorization adapters remain separate authority integrations
routing/page context is descriptive runtime context, not an authorization boundary
